name: session-cards
description: Session stats above the prompt: repo folder, branch and session name, then cards for model, effort, context, startup, limits and cost

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: colorful is a color per card, muted the same colors toned down, mono one light grey for everything, mono-diff the same with muted green and red on the file changes

showBranch.title: Show branch
showBranch.description: The repo folder and current git branch, above the cards

showSession.title: Show session name
showSession.description: The name set with /rename or --name, above the cards

showAccount.title: Show account
showAccount.description: The email of the Claude account you are logged in with, above the cards

showEffort.title: Show effort card
showEffort.description: The effort level from your settings

showContext.title: Show context card
showContext.description: How full the context window is

showStartup.title: Show startup card
showStartup.description: How much of the context window the session takes before the first prompt

showFiveHourLimit.title: Show 5h limit card
showFiveHourLimit.description: Usage of the 5 hour window and when it resets

showWeeklyLimit.title: Show weekly limit card
showWeeklyLimit.description: Usage of the weekly window and when it resets

showMonthlyLimit.title: Show monthly limit card
showMonthlyLimit.description: Usage of the monthly spend limit and when it resets
